purpose: Focused causal-attribution experiment at the 3-to-4 worker cliff identified by exp-2026-08-21-2c5c7311-d6b: measure provider-wait versus local-execution time, actual concurrency overlap, and per-process resources with six repetitions per worker count.
instrumentationNotes: Provider wait is the sum of matched [step_start -> step_finish] spans from OpenCode structured JSON output; inter-step gaps (step_finish -> next step_start) contain local tool execution plus runtime handoff and are deliberately not further decomposed because tool_use parts stream inside provider spans in this CLI format.
Per-process telemetry samples ps for agent processes attributed by their unique .worktrees/<attemptId> path.
Unavailable observability fields persist as null; unobserved wall time is an explicit bucket.
intendedCommand: node apps/cli/dist/index.js run --repo <clean-ledger-kit-copy> --tasks fixtures/ledger-kit/tasks.json --workers 3,4 --repetitions 6 --seed 20260817 --agent opencode --agent-model opencode/hy3-free --order worker-major --output experiments/opencode-runtime-attribution-3v4
